title: Affine descent datum from an invariant intersection of quasi-compact opens
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a ring homomorphism such that $p:X=\operatorname{Spec}A\to S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ is flat and surjective [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $V\to X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying scheme is quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], with descent datum $\varphi:V\times_S X\xrightarrow{\sim}X\times_S V$ [def-pd-descent-datum, def-pc-fibre-product], oriented so that $\varphi_{02}=\varphi_{12}\circ\varphi_{01}$. Let $E\subset |V|$ be an intersection of a nonempty set-indexed family of quasi-compact opens and assume $\varphi(E_0)=E_1$, where $E_0$ and $E_1$ are its inverse images in $V\times_S X$ and $X\times_S V$. Give each subset the inverse-image structure sheaf [def-a1-ringed-subspace], and put $C=\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_V|_E)$ [def-a1-intersection-structure-sections], with its $A$-algebra structure from $V\to X$. Then the canonical base-change maps identify the section rings on $E_0,E_1$ with $C\otimes_R A,A\otimes_R C$. Under these identifications the comorphism of $\varphi|_{E_0}$ is an $A\otimes_R A$-algebra isomorphism $\psi:A\otimes_R C\xrightarrow{\sim}C\otimes_R A$. After the canonical iterated section-ring identifications on the triple overlap its pullbacks satisfy $\psi_{02}=\psi_{01}\circ\psi_{12}$. In particular, on $Z=\operatorname{Spec}C\to X$ the isomorphism $\theta=\operatorname{Spec}\psi:Z\times_S X\xrightarrow{\sim}X\times_S Z$ is a descent datum with $\theta_{02}=\theta_{12}\circ\theta_{01}$. This affine scheme datum is effective: there exist an $S$-scheme $Z_0$ and a datum-compatible $X$-isomorphism $Z_0\times_S X\cong Z$. The section-ring identifications used here are the canonical maps $c\otimes a\mapsto g^\sharp(c)a$ for the relevant projections $g$, compatible with their iterates.

proof.text: Prove functoriality and identity for the canonical intersection sheaf maps from their defining pullback-pushforward adjunction unit, and hence for their global section maps. Invariance and the involution of the original descent overlap give an isomorphism b on sections. Set psi=alpha1 followed by b followed by alpha0 inverse. The canonical pure tensor formula and scalar-map naturality prove the stated two-scalar formula.

proof.text: Let M identify the spectrum of sections on the original double overlap with the double overlap of the affine model. Define its action k by conjugating Spec of the section map induced by the original transport. Scalar naturality proves that k lies over the second projection. The diagonal and the identity of the original transport prove the identity law for k.

proof.text: Apply the same section comparison once more, with Y the original double overlap and T=A, to identify the spectrum of sections on its further pullback with the triple overlap of the affine model. The inverse-image opens remain quasi-compact because the first projection is affine; the double overlap is quasi-separated for the same reason. Under this identification both affine action composites are spectra of section maps of the original action composites, which agree by the original transport cocycle. Cancel this comparison isomorphism to obtain the affine action cocycle for every test scheme.

proof.text: Construct the transport-form datum F from the action k, its identity law and its cocycle. Check its universal overlap against Spec psi by the two pullback projections, scalar naturality, and contravariant functoriality of intersection section maps. The defining conjugation formula for psi gives exactly the required coordinate equality.
